closing.text: For this property, WhataHotel's preferred rate adds complimentary Wi-Fi access, a priority upgrade when one is available at check-in, complimentary breakfast for two each day, and a $100 hotel credit, or $200 for suites. That preferred-rate offer can also be combined with the hotel's listed exclusive perks, subject to each offer's terms.
